patch_description: This candidate merges symmetry-aware parameter sharing from the best-performing seeds with the tunable two-qubit CRZ entanglers that align well with Z-basis readout. The block is compact (moderate unique parameter count) to improve parameter efficiency and reduce overfitting, while preserving expressive mixing by including shared RX mixing and small final RY adjustments. Corners are split into two paired classes to capture light asymmetry, edges share a single parameter, and RZ pre-phases are globally shared to regularize. Ring and hub CRZs remain learnable but shared across their respective edge classes to keep gate count useful but parameters economical. This balances expressivity and generalization (smaller train-test gap) while keeping depth/gate-count reasonable for faster convergence.
